summary: L4 quantification deliverable (27 antihypertensive l4_clinical values) produced by read-only oracle lane ora-1 was never persisted to disk; payload lived only in the ephemeral session buffer and was lost on lane close.
root_cause: 5-Why: (1) deliverable produced in oracle lane's response buffer only; (2) oracle lane is read-only, cannot write JSON files itself; (3) orchestrator dispatched a write-required quantification task to a read-only lane without a persistence plan; (4) orchestrator did not verify the full payload was captured inside the returned task result before closing the lane; (5) assumption that long JSON survives in the ephemeral response buffer. Root cause: lane-role persistence mismatch not detected at dispatch time.
impact: Required full regeneration via fresh lane ora-5 (~40 min). Final deliverable unaffected (regenerated values merged and spot-check APPROVE). Wasted 1 lane + 2 mis-routed resume attempts (ora-3, ora-4).
corrective_action: CAPA-2026-009: read-only specialist lanes must persist deliverables to a permitted path themselves, or the orchestrator must require the full payload inside the returned task result before lane close. Tracked in qms/capa/open/.
